name: Nash push/fold ranges for 6-max and 9-max tournament poker
description: Chip-EV Nash push/fold (shove-or-fold) frequencies for all 169 starting-hand classes, every seat that can open-shove in 6-max and 9-max, at stacks from 1 to 25 big blinds. Each row gives the push frequency and a shove/mixed/fold verdict.
attribution: RangeMyHand Nash push/fold ranges (www.rangemyhand.com), CC BY 4.0

model.stackConvention: stack in big blinds behind the posted blinds
